name: Aganau IF
divergenceSummary: Petelgeuse massacres Rem while Subaru is restrained, and Subaru's checkpoint updates past her death. Realizing he cannot reverse her fate, Subaru spends twenty bitter years as a vengeful swordsman wandering the continent.
headline: The Vengeful Swordsman's Path
description: Following Rem's death, Subaru spends twenty bitter years training his body and blade to exact relentless vengeance on the Witch Cult.

events.name: The Irreversible Loss in the Forest
events.description: Subaru witnesses Rem's death at Petelgeuse's hands, only to awaken at a save point after her body is cold. Realizing he cannot reverse her fate, his sanity fractures.

events.name: Twenty Years of Solitary Sword Discipline
events.description: Subaru departs the camp, sharpening his physical strength and spirit magic into lethal instruments of war, scarred from head to toe.

events.name: The Vengeful Blade's Reckoning
events.description: A weathered, graying Subaru corners Petelgeuse in the temple crypts, severing his invisible fingers one by one to fulfill two decades of unrelenting vengeance.
